newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Apr wholesale inventories fell 0.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Apr wholesale inventories fell 0.7 pct.

text.p: Commerce Department report of wholesale inventories and sales, seasonally adjusted.
(Billions of dollars) Apr Mar--Rev from Apr96
(Billions of dollars) Apr Mar--Rev from Apr96
The April stock-to-sales ratio for merchant wholesalers, seasonally adjusted, was unchanged from a revised 1.23 months' worth in March that previously reported as being 1.24 months.
The ratio is a measure of how many months it would take to sell existing inventories at the current sales pace.

The 0.7 percent drop in April inventories was the first decline in stocks of goods since last September when they also fell 0.7 percent. Inventories were flat in December but had risen in each of the three months from January through March before April's drop, the department said.
